snippet.title: Silver Lake National Park _ Alpha Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Silver Lake National Park, where Ranger Logan keeps the trails clear, the campfires warm, and the supernatural community hidden in plain sight. He's a werebear who learned long ago not to fight what he is. These days he makes sure everyone feels at home, even when he can't always feel it.

Wishlist & Follow on Steam. Playtesting Opening Soon. https://store.steampowered.com/app/4182280/Silver_Lake_National_Park/
